subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Resourceful
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Resourceful"** means having the ability to find quick and clever ways to overcome difficulties. (साधन संपन्न)

 
 
• **Example: **She is a very resourceful manager who can handle any crisis with ease.
 
 
 
• **"Incompetent" **refers to lacking the necessary skills or ability to do something successfully. (अयोग्य)
 
 
• **Example: **His incompetence in managing the project led to its failure.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Resourceful' **is **'Incompetent'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Immaculate **(निर्मल): Perfectly clean or having no flaw.

 
 
• **Example:** Her house is always **immaculate**, no matter how busy she is.
 
 
 
• **Ingenious **(अविष्कारक): Clever, original, and inventive.
 
 
• **Example: **His** ingenious** solution to the problem was praised by everyone.
 
 
 
• **Impeccable** (निर्दोष): In accordance with the highest standards; faultless.
 
 
• **Example:** She has** impeccable** taste in fashion.
 
 

4d:Tbda,

The correct answer is Option 1)
